judge.system: You label screenshots from original Xbox games running in an emulator. Reply with one word.
judge.ask: Is the player in control of gameplay in this screenshot? Answer INGAME if it shows gameplay: the game world with the player's character, vehicle, cursor or pieces under the player's control, usually with a HUD (score, health, map, speedometer, ammo, timer), including a pause menu drawn over gameplay. Answer OTHER for anything else: black or blank screens, logos, legal or warning screens, videos and cutscenes (including in-engine scenes with letterbox bars or no HUD), title screens, menus, character, car or level selection, profile and save prompts, loading screens and briefings. Answer with one word: INGAME or OTHER.

guide.system: You operate the gamepad of an original Xbox game running in an emulator, to get from its menus into gameplay. Reply with one JSON object only.
guide.ask: This screenshot shows where the game is now. It is not gameplay yet, and pressing Start and A in turn did not get past it. Give the button presses, in order, that most likely move on toward gameplay from exactly this screen: start a new single-player game with the defaults, accept the default name, character, car, team, difficulty and settings, confirm prompts, skip videos. Rules: read the button hints on the screen and use the button they name for confirm, done, accept, next or continue. On an on-screen keyboard, do not type: move the highlighted cursor to DONE, OK, ACCEPT, ENTER or END with the direction buttons and press A, or press the button the screen names for it (often Start or Y); if the name is empty, press A once on a letter first. On a prompt that asks whether to continue without saving, without a profile or without signing in, choose the answer that continues. On a prompt that asks whether to overwrite or delete saved data, do not overwrite or delete; go back or pick another entry. Where a list offers a new game, a quick race, exhibition, arcade or practice mode, pick the one that reaches play soonest. If the screen is black, a logo, a loading screen or a video, reply with no presses, or Start to skip a video. At most 10 presses, counted from the cursor position visible in the screenshot. Buttons: a b x y start back up down left right lt rt white black. Reply as {"presses": ["down", "a"], "screen": "what the screen is, in a few words"}.
